description: This file defines the 'Download' class which encapsulates functionality related to handling download artifacts within a web automation context. It provides methods to access download information, save files, create read streams, and control download lifecycle.

classes.name: Download
classes.description: Represents a download within a page context, allowing interaction with the downloaded file and its metadata.

methods.name: page
methods.description: Returns the Page instance associated with this download.

methods.name: url
methods.description: Returns the URL from which the download originated.

methods.name: suggestedFilename
methods.description: Returns the filename suggested for saving the download.

methods.name: path
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the file system path of the finished download artifact.

methods.name: saveAs
methods.description: Saves the downloaded file to the specified path.

methods.name: failure
methods.description: Returns any failure message if the download failed, otherwise null.

methods.name: createReadStream
methods.description: Creates a Readable stream of the download content.
